notes.title: Update - 10/25
notes.content:
Hello Street Fighter fans,

As a follow-up to yesterday's announcement, pre-purchase customers will no longer be forced to download and install the Japanese version.

We're still looking into matters for those who have inadvertently downloaded the Japanese version.  Please stay tuned for further updates.

Once again, we apologize for the confusion and inconvenience this may have caused.

tags.feature: pre-purchase customers will no longer be forced to download and install the Japanese version.
